description: An operator's number of scans is how many scan records they have.

b.request: For operators with non-null per-scan GB-per-minute values whose average GB per minute exceeds the unweighted average of those per-operator averages, return one row with their average number of scan records, their average GB per minute, and the average difference between each qualifying operator’s GB-per-minute average and the unweighted average across all operators
b.sql:
WITH operator_averages AS (
  SELECT
    crewref,
    AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min
  FROM scans
  GROUP BY crewref
  HAVING COUNT(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) > 0
), qualifying_operators AS (
  SELECT crewref, avg_gb_per_min
  FROM operator_averages
  WHERE avg_gb_per_min > (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) FROM operator_averages)
), operator_scan_counts AS (
  SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans
  GROUP BY crewref
)
SELECT
  AVG(osc.scan_count) AS average_scan_records,
  AVG(qo.avg_gb_per_min) AS average_gb_per_min,
  AVG(qo.avg_gb_per_min - (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) FROM operator_averages)) AS average_difference
FROM qualifying_operators qo
JOIN operator_scan_counts osc USING (crewref);

a.request: For each operator (`scans.crewref`), find their number of scans by counting their scan records, and find their average file size per minute, computed per scan as `gbsize` ÷ `spanmin`. Ignore missing values. Consider only operators whose average GB per minute is above the simple average of that figure across all operators. In a single row, give the average number of scans of those operators, their average GB per minute, and their average margin above the all-operator average, with no rounding.
a.sql:
WITH per_operator AS (
  SELECT
    crewref,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count,
    AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND spanmin <> 0
  GROUP BY crewref
),
all_operator_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM per_operator
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT p.scan_count, p.avg_gb_per_minute, a.avg_gb_per_minute AS all_avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM per_operator p
  CROSS JOIN all_operator_average a
  WHERE p.avg_gb_per_minute > a.avg_gb_per_minute
)
SELECT
  AVG(scan_count) AS average_scan_count,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS average_gb_per_minute,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_minute - all_avg_gb_per_minute) AS average_margin_above_all_operator_average
FROM above_average;

c.request: Look at the operators (`scans.crewref`) whose average file size per minute, computed per scan as `gbsize` ÷ `spanmin` with missing values ignored, is above the simple average of that figure across all operators. In a single row, how many scans have these operators done on average, what is their average GB per minute, and by how much on average do they exceed the all-operator figure? Don't round. An operator's number of scans is how many scan records they have.
c.sql:
WITH operator_averages AS (
  SELECT
    crewref,
    AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans
  GROUP BY crewref
),
all_operator_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM operator_averages
),
above_average_operators AS (
  SELECT oa.scan_count, oa.avg_gb_per_minute, all_avg.avg_gb_per_minute AS overall_avg
  FROM operator_averages oa
  CROSS JOIN all_operator_average all_avg
  WHERE oa.avg_gb_per_minute > all_avg.avg_gb_per_minute
)
SELECT
  AVG(scan_count) AS avg_scans_per_operator,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_minute - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_gb_per_minute
FROM above_average_operators;

d.request: Considering only operators whose average `gbsize ÷ spanmin` per scan (ignoring missing values) is above the simple average of that figure across all operators, return one row with: their average number of scan records, their average GB per minute, and how much that average exceeds the average across all operators. Do not round.
d.sql:
WITH operator_averages AS (
  SELECT crewref, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0
  GROUP BY crewref
), above_average AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM operator_averages
  WHERE avg_gb_per_minute > (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) FROM operator_averages)
), operator_scan_counts AS (
  SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_records
  FROM scans
  GROUP BY crewref
)
SELECT AVG(c.scan_records) AS average_scan_records,
       AVG(a.avg_gb_per_minute) AS average_gb_per_minute,
       AVG(a.avg_gb_per_minute) - (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) FROM operator_averages) AS excess_over_all_operators
FROM above_average a
JOIN operator_scan_counts c ON c.crewref = a.crewref;
